title: Methods Of Credit Control Quality Quantity Control Measures
definition: Credit control refers to the monetary policy instruments utilized by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to regulate the volume, cost, and direction of bank credit in the economy to achieve price stability coupled with economic growth.
importanceInUpsc: Central to UPSC Civil Services Prelims (Economy section on RBI monetary policy tools, liquidity management) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Indian Economy, mobilization of resources, growth, development, inflation management).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Methods Of Credit Control Quality Quantity Control Measures.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Banking, Inflation, Money Supply, and RBI Functions
